title: Worth it for a few months.
text: My cats did really enjoy this box for the first few months. But every month the toys are similar. The treats were never a hit here. We got cat wine a few times and not one single cat here would drink it. I foster for a rescue and have had up to 17 cats. We also got multiple months of Wellness treats that the cats didn't really care for. I loved getting the teaser wands every month and there usually was at least one other toy the cats would love. So out of 5 items, only two were a hit every month. The themes were also kinda boring. I was disappointed for the lack of holiday themes with months that had holidays, like Valentine's and St. Patrick's. The box was fun and worth for a couple months but after 8 months of receiving it, I did cancel.
label: positive
